important_context: T6 deliverables (e2e/support/import.ics, e2e/tests/desktop-mvp.spec.ts import journey, README.md) are committed in f8c39b9 and clean vs HEAD; docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md records T6 complete.

The E2E desktop project runs against pre-built artifacts: backend/target/debug/commoncal-backend and frontend/dist, plus installed browsers (via e2e/support/isolatedBackend.ts on an ephemeral port with a disposable SQLite DB); all must exist and be current before running.

The API contract in backend/src/event.rs (EventProjection, mark_external_projections) sets is_external/read_only to Some(true) only for events in external_event_mapping and omits them (skip_serializing_if) for native events — this is why the E2E test's not.toHaveProperty assertions are a valid proof of non-externality.
Uncommitted working-tree changes to backend/src/event.rs, backend/tests/ics_import.rs, and mcp-server/* belong to other tasks and were preserved untouched by the T6 stage.
